text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Year-end, the Arima Kinen. With T.M. Opera 
O, Meisho Doto, and Admire Vega all 
gathered for the winter Grand Prix race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road had also been chosen to 
enter the race. Welcomed by thunderous 
cheers, she stepped into the paddock 
alongside her generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Words are no longer needed. All that's 
left is to run and let our strides do the 
talking.
